summary: Iteration 111: تم التحقق من إصلاحات لوحة المؤشرات المالية. جميع الـ APIs تعمل بشكل صحيح (200 OK). البيانات تُعرض بشكل صحيح بعد انتظار اكتمال طلبات الشبكة. صافي الدخل يُعرض بقيمة 44,810 ر.س. والذمم 21,982 ر.س.

integration_issues.issue: API requests get aborted (net::ERR_ABORTED) when navigating between pages quickly. This causes data to not load initially. Waiting for networkidle resolves the issue.
integration_issues.workaround: Wait for networkidle when navigating to the page

critical_code_review_comments: ✅ unwrapApiData function correctly parses API responses
✅ Non-blocking loading implemented - UI elements appear immediately
✅ Loading banner disappears after data loads
✅ Net income shows 44,810 SAR (not zero) when there's actual data
✅ Receivables shows 21,982 SAR from AR customers API
context_for_next_testing_agent: Finance dashboard is working correctly. All APIs return 200 OK with valid data. The frontend correctly displays net income (44,810 SAR), receivables (21,982 SAR), and expenses (735 SAR). The loading banner disappears after data loads. Note: When navigating quickly between pages, API requests may be aborted - this is normal browser behavior and the data loads correctly when waiting for networkidle.
